catalogue_requests.reason: cap.motion.joint_position.v1 takes a flat joint_positions array and requires reached and joint_positions outputs. The pinned ROS 2 controller action is control_msgs/action/FollowJointTrajectory: its goal carries trajectory.points, an array of point objects, and its terminal result is error_code and error_string. RosDriver argument targets must be object field paths (no array indices), so the flat class cannot be placed into trajectory.points; the class output also does not match the native result. The extension keeps the controller's trajectory and terminal-result semantics.
catalogue_requests.summary: Send one JointTrajectory point through /arm_controller/follow_joint_trajectory and report the terminal error_code.

catalogue_requests.reason: cap.manipulation.grasp.v1 takes force in N and width in mm and reports grasped and width_mm. The pinned GripperCommand action takes command.position in the gripper joint's native position unit and command.max_effort in the controller's native effort unit, and its result is reached_goal, stalled, position and effort. Binding the grasp class would change the units and the control shape, and the clone states no installed-gripper force or width conversion. The extension preserves the native controller contract.
catalogue_requests.summary: Send a control_msgs/action/GripperCommand goal to /gripper_controller/gripper_cmd and report its terminal fields.

catalogue_requests.reason: cap.sensing.read.v1 is restricted to sensor, sensor.imu and sensor.force_torque resource kinds. This device is robot.arm, and the pinned observation is a sensor_msgs/msg/JointState message with parallel name, position and velocity arrays. The extension carries that message shape without relabelling the arm as a sensor.
The ordinary fixed SetBool(false) request reports only an external torque-service acknowledgement. It does not establish gravity-safe cessation and is not a safe-state or estop action.
catalogue_requests.summary: Disable joint torque through the external acknowledged dynamixel_hardware_interface set_dxl_torque SetBool service.
